purpose: Connect the 18 primary-crosschecked BaBar RF0 transverse-momentum candidate amplitudes to fixed-parameter Julia predictions at reported means. This prerequisite diagnostic supplies no likelihood, optimizer, experimental acceptance, historical-fit reproduction or production admission.

selection.kinematics: Use literal candidate z1,z2,Q2,pT means in source order. The primary table crosscheck includes z1,z2,pT, pT bin edges and the angular scalar. The legacy Q2=112.36 GeV2 is retained as a conditional source-literal input, not a newly primary-verified beam-energy value; do not replace it with 10.58^2 or refit it.
selection.cuts: Retain all 18 selected candidates and existing exclusions. Record the source qT<3.5 GeV requirement and each fixed-model pT/z1 value separately. Do not infer an event average or apply a new cut on a ratio of means. Other P-integrated SIA views remain pending and are not replaced by point evaluations.
selection.units: Use the existing normalized fraction-valued amplitudes/errors. Original BaBar percent conversion is applied exactly once by source preparation; no further percent or Belle-erratum correction.
selection.source_integrity: Rebuild and verify all current historical intake outputs. Bind all raw/primary inputs, candidate/report hashes, scientific contracts, code fingerprint, source rows and exact order. Reconstruct source-derived requests during cache verification; changed or merely rehashed provenance must reject.

primary_definition.table: tab:totPt, uniquely identified RF0 section with theta2 and A0 columns
primary_definition.source_fact: The RF0 hadron-2 observable is the cos(2phi0) modulation of unlike/like (UL) and unlike/all (UC) normalized-yield double ratios. The source angular table reports mean[sin^2(theta2)/(1+cos^2(theta2))].
primary_definition.model_parent: KPSY arXiv:1505.05589v1 Eqs76-86 and the existing polarized-process/leptonic-observable contracts
primary_definition.conditional_mapping: Factor the reported mean-of-angular-ratio scalar from charge-category structure-function ratios evaluated at fixed reported kinematic means, using the inherited linearized double-ratio model. This is not recovery of a joint angle/kinematic acceptance average or exact nonlinear experimental double-ratio fitting.

prediction.parameters: Literal initial-contract.json published_parameters in the unchanged 13-coordinate order; fixed rounded Table1 inputs, not recovered author optimizer states or a new fitted optimum.
prediction.angular_source_type: SIAMeanOfRatio with the primary-table scalar, source identifier and retained publication averaging-measure/acceptance limitation. Do not substitute a ratio of separate means or reconstruct an angle from it.
prediction.categories: For pi+/pi- pairs retain all four inherited charge-conjugate flavor sums: unlike U=(+,-)+(-,+), like L=(+,+)+(-,-), all C=U+L. Assemble each signed Collins numerator and positive unpolarized denominator separately.
prediction.formula: A_UL=Ftheta*(C_U/D_U-C_L/D_L); A_UC=Ftheta*(C_U/D_U-(C_U+C_L)/(D_U+D_L)). Preserve the inherited SIA J2/mass/z factors and physical Wilson/CSS conventions. Apply Ftheta once, with no SIDIS DNN factor, new factor2, absolute-value numerator or asymmetry clamp.
prediction.momentum: Evaluate the fixed-P hadron2 SIA point plan at each reported pT mean. This contract supplies no P-bin or P-integrated acceptance approximation.
prediction.context_reuse: Reuse the exact same prepared SIA context across UL/UC and the four charge categories only for exactly equal z1,z2,Q2,pT/model/input settings. Preserve all point identities. No rounding-based geometry grouping, parameter-response cache or caller-supplied trusted digest.
prediction.inputs: Current pinned CT10/DSSV08/DSS14 and retained HOPPET receipts, strict Q0 samples, explicit reference continuation/extrapolation audits at unsupported Fourier scales, and current bridge source/binary hash checks. Original author-modified HOPPET remains unavailable.
prediction.loop: Julia owns predictions, category assembly, reference arithmetic and any derivatives/optimization/uncertainty. Python/Snakemake schedules complete jobs and renders their completed outputs. No Python, provider/native or language-model callback inside a numerical parameter evaluation.

numerical_policy.acceptance: Require at least three frozen joint native/matching/radial levels. For every selected point, all four charge-pair UU and signed Collins yields, U/L/C sums and the final linearized amplitude must meet the unchanged 1e-4 adjacent-level target. At the accepted setting compare the 24-to32 finite radial extension at the same target. Retain every coarse value/target miss; exhausted refinement or resource budgets remain FAIL. No infinite-tail proof is inferred.
numerical_policy.independent_reference: At final fixed native rows use the existing independent scalar charge/CSS/Bessel assembly for all four pair yields, category sums and both normalized amplitudes at every geometry, under 1e-4. Shared native rows, initial functions and source inputs are not independent evolution. Retain reference and implementation operands.
numerical_policy.source_convention_check: Use 256-bit independent uniform phi0 projection over [0,2pi] of the first derivative at epsilon=0 of positive normalized-yield double ratios. Freeze D_U=2,D_L=1,C_U=+/-1/8,C_L=-/+1/16,C_C=C_U+C_L, with N_i(phi0,epsilon)=D_i+epsilon*Ftheta*C_i*cos(2phi0); N_C=N_U+N_L. Project the analytic quotient derivative with cos(2phi0)/pi for UL and UC at every actual Ftheta. This explicitly synthetic linearization fixture does not validate finite-amplitude experimental extraction or acceptance. Retain omitted/repeated-Ftheta, factor2, wrong category, cos(phi0)/sin(2phi0) harmonic and sign counterfactuals.
numerical_policy.fixed_value_controls: Verify exact category/yield algebra and positivity, all point IDs/order, shared UL/UC charge-row preparation, independence of the first six transversity coordinates and invariance under simultaneous sign reversal of both Collins normalizations. Retain producer object-reuse and temporal checks as attestations, separate from recomputable arithmetic.
numerical_policy.derivative_scope: Fixed-parameter diagnostic only. It does not establish production gradients, fitting throughput or interval coverage. Inherited all-parameter derivative validation remains separate.

observations_and_products.errors: Preserve statistical_error and reported_systematic separately. Retain UL/UC sample overlap and all covariance/acceptance blockers. Construct no covariance, combined errors, normalization nuisance, chi2, pulls, likelihood or parameter intervals.
observations_and_products.residual: Only optional unweighted observed-minus-predicted differences, labeled as diagnostic scalars.
observations_and_products.artifacts: Source-bound request; complete Julia report retaining raw refinement, tail, charge/category, angular and independent-reference operands; a CSV preserving source values and numerical fields, and a discrete UL/UC data/fixed-theory figure. Raw sources, build products and outputs stay out of Git.
observations_and_products.audit: A separately invoked Julia auditor must check exact current request/source/contract/build bindings and independently recompute retained scalar arithmetic. Explicitly identify any producer attestations and operations not replayed. A marker alone cannot approve a cached result.
observations_and_products.failure_retention: Declare completion-only scheduler outputs; retain original numerical/audit/invocation/log artifacts on failure. Fresh paths are required. Explicitly synthetic whole-job failure controls and forged-marker rejection authorize no numerical or production result.

required_checks: real-source complete SIA point pipeline and source/point-cache controls
controls: integrated view replaced by its mean P
numerical failure and exhausted refinement retained
validation_policy.status_policy: Only this complete declared diagnostic may pass. Missing, stale, failed or unimplemented checks remain FAIL. Synthetic receipts and source-only reviews cannot authorize experimental data or production fits.
